management_steps.details: Triage as ORANGE. Check FBC, malaria smear & antigen. Look for high-risk criteria: children, pregnant, elderly, splenectomy.

If smear/antigen positive with < 5% parasitaemia and no organ dysfunction: give Co-artem 4 tablets PO stat, 4 after 8 hours, then BD for 2 days. If unavailable: Quinine + Doxycycline (or Quinine + Clindamycin in pregnancy/children).

Smear > 5%, or any organ dysfunction (coma, convulsions, pulmonary edema, shock, jaundice, severe anaemia Hb < 5, hypoglycemia < 2.2, lactate > 5): Give Artesunate 2.4 mg/kg IV stat at 0, 12, 24 hours. (Alternative: Quinine infusion).

warnings: Observe for vomiting for 1 hour in the ED after oral antimalarial. If vomiting occurs within 1 hour, re-administer the dose. If vomiting persists, refer to Internal Medicine.
